newsitem.title: PERU: Peru wholesale prices rise 0.90 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: Peru wholesale prices rise 0.90 pct in September.

text.p: Peru's wholesale prices rose 0.90 percent in September, up from 0.48 percent in the same month last year and from 0.78 percent in August, the National Institute of Statistics and Information (INEI) said Thursday.
In the first nine months of 1996, wholesale prices rose 8.40 percent, up from from 7.07 percent in the same period of 1996.
Wholesale prices rose 10.20 percent in the last 12 months up to September, the INEI added.
In 1995, accumulated inflation for wholesale prices was 8.8 percent, up from 10.5 percent the previous year.
